comment: Every node's @type becomes an array of prefixed names, whether or not its class has a row.

The dataset's @id: https://data.niaid.nih.gov/resources?id=<_id>. _id is not a URI by itself. OPEN QUESTION: whether _id is stable across index builds is not established, and the portal returns 200 for unknown ids. One of 3 rows for ndeapi:_id: the others give schema:about, schema:identifier.
The catalog record is about the dataset: a reference to the dataset's @id. One of 3 rows for ndeapi:_id: the others give @id, schema:identifier.
When there is no DOI, BioProject accession or identifier: the dataset's @id. One of 3 rows for ndeapi:_id: the others give @id, schema:about.

First DOI among doi then identifier, else first BioProject accession (PRJ[DEN][A-Z]digits), as a PropertyValue naming its identifiers.org registry; else the first identifier value as given. One of 2 rows for nde:doi: the others give bios:alternateIdentifier.
Every doi and identifier value except the one used as schema:identifier. One of 2 rows for nde:doi: the others give schema:identifier.
As for doi. One of 2 rows for nde:identifier: the others give bios:alternateIdentifier.
Other values, as for doi. One of 2 rows for nde:identifier: the others give schema:identifier.
Required by CDIF core; first row to fill it wins.
One of 2 rows for nde:datePublished: the others give schema:dateModified.
First fallback when the record has no dateModified: the portal's latest of dateModified, datePublished and dateCreated. One of 2 rows for nde:date: the others give nde:date.
Only when the record has no dateModified or date. One of 2 rows for nde:datePublished: the others give schema:datePublished.
One of 2 rows for nde:dateCreated: the others give schema:dateModified.
Only when there is no dateModified, date or datePublished. One of 2 rows for nde:dateCreated: the others give schema:dateCreated.
The portal's own summary date. One of 2 rows for nde:date: the others give schema:dateModified.
Not in NIAID's schema or Bioschemas, so the cdifNIAID profile defines it.
Authors are creators. Used as the creator list when the record has no creator; otherwise the creator row adds authors not already listed.
A url-less CreativeWork gets a url from its DOI, PMID or identifier; failing that it becomes its citation text or name.
An array of agents, typed as for creator.
CDIF's creator is an ordered @list; authors not already named are added after the creators. An agent with no @type is typed as Person or Organization.
Required by CDIF core. Several values, or several rows targeting it, are joined with a blank line, duplicates skipped.
Joined to the description, after it.
Untyped values become schema:DataDownload.
Grants naming no funder, identifier or name are dropped; several funders become one grant per funder.
Parts with an address: the manifest's dataset-level parts. An untyped part is taken as a CreativeWork. One of 3 rows for nde:hasPart: the others give schema:hasPart, cdifniaid:unlinkedHasPart.

Parts with no address when the record has exactly one distribution: files in that bundle, as manifest archive parts (MediaObject; a format not given is guessed from the file name, else application/octet-stream). The distribution is typed schema:Collection. One of 3 rows for nde:hasPart: the others give schema:hasPart, cdifniaid:unlinkedHasPart.

Parts with no address when there is no single distribution to hold them. Not in NIAID's schema or Bioschemas, so the cdifNIAID profile defines it. One of 3 rows for nde:hasPart: the others give schema:hasPart, schema:hasPart.
The first value; a language object becomes its name.
The repositories holding the dataset. The catalog record's includedInDataCatalog is the portal, set by the harvester.
Sources with an address as labelled links (CreativeWork with url); others as their name.

Each related resource with an address as a LinkRole; linkRelationship is the portal's relationship (e.g. 'Datasets in the same study') where given, else nde:isRelatedTo. One of 2 rows for nde:isRelatedTo: the others give nde:isRelatedTo.

Related resources with no address, which cannot be links (most are other portal records named only by identifier), kept as the portal gives them. One of 2 rows for nde:isRelatedTo: the others give schema:relatedLink.
A string is split on commas.
Array. Runs even when absent: with no license and no access statement, the OGC nil value for missing.
Each URL as a LinkRole with linkRelationship nde:mainEntityOfPage. URLs packed into one string with commas or semicolons are split.
Objects with no @type become schema:DefinedTerm.
Adds schema:Place beside the portal's type; strings become named places. Places with the same identifier are merged into one, keeping the one named from a country.
ISO 8601 interval strings: start/end, start/.., ../end. One of 2 rows for nde:temporalCoverage: the others give cdifniaid:temporalIntervals.

An interval holding more than its dates, kept whole. Not in NIAID's schema or Bioschemas, so the cdifNIAID profile defines it. One of 2 rows for nde:temporalCoverage: the others give schema:temporalCoverage.
Keywords as DefinedTerms with schema:about 'topicCategory'.
The repository's landing page.

Usage information with a url as a LinkRole with linkRelationship nde:usageInfo; name and description go on the LinkRole. Values without a url go to conditionsOfAccess (next row). One of 2 rows for nde:usageInfo: the others give schema:conditionsOfAccess.
Values with no url: their name and description become an access statement. One of 2 rows for nde:usageInfo: the others give schema:relatedLink.
Adds schema:PropertyValue beside the portal's type; strings become named values.
A term's classification becomes a dataset keyword: a DefinedTerm with schema:about 'NIAID classification'.

Who curated the term's annotation (often software, e.g. PubTator or GPT-4o-mini), kept on the term: CDIF contributors must be a Person or Organization.

The term's display name as its alternateName.

The portal gives a country only where the area's name is its ISO 3166 code (Project Tycho). The country becomes the name (see the name row) and the code goes here as an alternateName.
Only when the area has no name; otherwise the name row carries it in its DefinedTerm.
Consumed by the name row: the DefinedTerm's about.

The place's name as a DefinedTerm (spatialExtent allows a gazetteer term), carrying the area's identifier and its locationType as schema:about (not 'other'). Where a country is given, it is the name and the area's own name (the ISO code) is the termCode.
A CreativeWork with no url of any kind is typed schema:Thing, since CDIF reads a CreativeWork as a labelled link.
One of 2 rows for nde:pmid: the others give schema:identifier.

Parts given as objects. CDIF's archive parts need a name and format, so bare URLs go to cdifniaid:partUrl instead.
File URLs listed on a distribution (Dryad): each file can be fetched on its own, so each is a dataset-level part, a DataDownload at that URL.
